name: 未配置凭证
description: 网关中该提供商没有激活的凭证，请求在网关本地即被拒绝（HTTP 404），没有发往上游。
description_en: The gateway has no active credential for this provider; the request was rejected locally (HTTP 404) and never reached the upstream.
fix: 在网关中为该提供商添加或启用凭证。
fix_en: Add or enable a credential for the provider in the gateway.

name: 认证失败 (401/403)
description: 上游拒绝了凭证：OAuth token 失效/过期、API Key 无效或被停用。整个提供商下的模型都会同样失败。
description_en: The upstream rejected the credential: expired OAuth token, invalid or disabled API key. Every model behind the provider fails the same way.
fix: 重新登录 OAuth 或更换 API Key。
fix_en: Re-authenticate or replace the API key.

name: 余额不足，需充值
description: 上游账号余额为 0、积分不足或预扣费失败，拒绝了计费请求。属于账号级问题，与具体模型无关。
description_en: The upstream account has no balance or credits left; billing pre-authorisation failed. Account-level, unrelated to the model.
fix: 充值；免费额度类账号可更换账号。
fix_en: Top up the account or switch accounts.

name: 免费额度已用尽
description: 报错表明账号级的免费请求额度 / 免费模型配额 / 赠送 token 已用完（通常为 429），需等待窗口重置，而非瞬时限流。
description_en: The free request quota, free-model allowance or gifted tokens for the account are used up (usually 429); it resets with the quota window rather than being a momentary rate limit.
fix: 等待额度窗口重置、充值或更换账号。
fix_en: Wait for the quota window to reset, top up or switch accounts.

name: 套餐限制
description: 当前免费套餐不允许使用该（付费/高级）模型，或平台已暂停免费套餐，或账号无会员资格。
description_en: The current (free) plan does not allow this paid/premium model, the free plan is paused, or the account lacks a membership.
fix: 升级套餐，或只使用该平台标记为 free 的模型。
fix_en: Upgrade the plan or use the models marked as free.

name: 需先接受模型条款
description: 提供商要求组织管理员先在控制台接受该模型的使用条款。
description_en: The provider requires an organisation admin to accept the model's terms of use in the console first.
fix: 到提供商控制台接受条款后即可使用。
fix_en: Accept the terms in the provider console.

name: 限流 (429)
description: 上游瞬时 RPM/TPM 限制、按分钟计数的免费层请求上限，或聚合平台“所有渠道繁忙”；放慢并复测后仍失败。
description_en: Momentary RPM/TPM limits, per-minute free-tier caps or 'all channels busy' on an aggregator; still failing after slower retries.
fix: 降低调用频率、稍后重试。
fix_en: Reduce the request rate and retry later.

name: 模型不存在/不可用 (404/400)
description: 上游不认识该模型名、账号无权访问、模型已停用或暂时禁用；也包含网关本地直接判定“不支持”的模型。属于模型级问题。
description_en: The upstream does not know the model, the account cannot access it, or it is disabled; includes models the gateway rejects locally. Model-level.
fix: 从列表移除，或改用上游当前有效的模型名。
fix_en: Remove it from the list or switch to a currently valid model name.

name: 模型已下线 (410)
description: 上游明确告知该模型已停用/到期，多数给出了替代模型。
description_en: The upstream states the model reached end of life; most responses name a replacement.
fix: 按报错提示改用替代模型。
fix_en: Use the replacement model named in the error.

name: 非聊天模型
description: 上游明确说明该模型不支持 /v1/chat/completions（图像生成、OCR、语音、决策等专用端点）。
description_en: The upstream states the model does not support /v1/chat/completions (image generation, OCR, speech or other dedicated endpoints).
fix: 改用对应的专用端点。
fix_en: Use the dedicated endpoint for that modality.

name: 非聊天模型（按模型名推断）
name_en: Not a chat model (inferred from name)
description: 上游报“模型不存在或不支持 chat completions”，而模型名表明它是图像/视频/语音/嵌入类模型，本来就不走 chat 接口。
description_en: The upstream reported 'not found or not supported for chat', and the name indicates an image/video/audio/embedding model that never used the chat endpoint.
fix: 改用对应的专用端点。
fix_en: Use the dedicated endpoint for that modality.

name: 请求参数不兼容
description: 模型存在，但上游拒绝了网关发出的请求参数（如 thinking level、输入类型）。
description_en: The model exists but the upstream rejected a request parameter forwarded by the gateway (thinking level, input type, ...).
fix: 调整该提供商/模型的参数策略后重试。
fix_en: Adjust the parameter policy for the provider/model and retry.

name: 暂无可用容量
description: 聚合平台回复“当前没有可用容量，请稍后再试”；最终复测仍失败。
description_en: The aggregator replied 'no capacity available right now'; still failing on the final retry.
fix: 稍后重试。
fix_en: Retry later.

name: 平台无可用渠道
description: 聚合平台报该模型在当前分组下没有可用渠道/部署，属于该平台的配置问题。
description_en: The aggregator has no channel/deployment for the model in the current group; a platform configuration issue.
fix: 换用其它提供商的同名模型。
fix_en: Use the same model from a different provider.

name: 接口不支持 (405)
description: 网关的该提供商适配器不支持 chat completions 调用方式。
description_en: The gateway adapter for this provider does not support the chat completions call.
fix: 改用该提供商原生接口，或等待网关适配。
fix_en: Use the provider's native API or wait for gateway support.

name: 上游返回空内容
description: 上游连接成功但没有返回任何内容（复测仍如此）。
description_en: The upstream connection succeeded but returned no content (also on retry).
fix: 更换模型或稍后重试。
fix_en: Switch models or retry later.

name: 上游网络故障
description: 网关连接上游时 fetch failed / 连接被重置 / TLS 握手失败 / 网关错误。
description_en: The gateway failed to reach the upstream: fetch failed, connection reset, TLS handshake failure or bad gateway.
fix: 检查代理与上游域名可达性。
fix_en: Check proxies and upstream reachability.

name: 上游 5xx
description: 上游服务端内部错误或暂时不可用；复测仍失败。
description_en: Upstream server error or temporary unavailability; still failing on retry.
fix: 稍后重试。
fix_en: Retry later.

name: 超时
description: 客户端在超时阈值内没有收到完整响应。
description_en: No complete response arrived within the client timeout.
fix: 模型过慢或请求挂起；可单独用更长超时验证。
fix_en: The model is slow or the request hung; verify with a longer timeout.

name: 本地网络错误
description: 无法连接端点。
description_en: The endpoint could not be reached.
fix: 检查端点地址、代理与网络。
fix_en: Check the endpoint URL, proxy and network.

name: 请求被拒绝 (400)
description: 上游或网关以 400 拒绝请求（输入校验失败等，非“模型不存在”类）。
description_en: The upstream or gateway rejected the request with 400 (validation failure, not a missing model).
fix: 查看报错原文。
fix_en: Inspect the error message.

name: 200 但含错误体
description: 上游返回 HTTP 200，但响应体是错误对象。
description_en: The upstream returned HTTP 200 but the body is an error object.
fix: 查看报错原文。
fix_en: Inspect the error message.

name: 客户端异常
description: 测试客户端内部异常。
description_en: Internal client error.
fix: 查看报错原文。
fix_en: Inspect the error message.

name: 未知错误
description: 无法归类。
description_en: Could not be classified.
fix: 查看报错原文。
fix_en: Inspect the error message.

name: 用户跳过
description: 用户在运行过程中跳过了该模型：在途请求被取消，后续轮次与阶段不再测试它。
description_en: The user skipped this model while the run was in progress: the in-flight request was cancelled and later rounds and stages leave it out.
fix: 重新运行以获得该模型的结果；通常意味着它响应过慢。
fix_en: Re-run to measure it; usually it means the model was too slow to respond.

name: 未测试
description: 没有任何测试记录。
description_en: No attempts recorded.
